2.0.0

2026-07-02
New
  • rebuilt on the v3 keyframeless timing engine - animate any property with keyposes, basic and advanced views, no keyframes
  • centerline tracing
  • moveable toolbar
  • AI integration
  • presets
  • interactive guides, including the animated arrow guide
Improved
  • much faster tessellation, hit-testing, and mini-canvas rendering for large paths
  • proper 3D depth layer rendering
Fixed
  • pinch to zoom when the popover isn't focused
  • backspace deleting the layer instead of a character while renaming
  • marker width not hiding when set to none
  • prefer anchor over curve handle when both are under the cursor
Changelog begins at 2.0.0. Earlier releases are on GitHub.
Canvas is a Final Cut Pro FxPlug effect, part of the Keyframeless suite.
